description: Storydoc turns your presentation templates into finished, personalized decks from a conversation. Browse the templates in your Storydoc account, fill their variables to create a new version for a specific client, or generate a brand-new deck from scratch with the AI wizard. Every deck lands in your Storydoc account and comes back as a shareable short URL. You can also ask how your decks are performing and get engagement totals, top stories and versions, and breakdowns by device and location.

defaultPrompt: Which of my templates fit a sales proposal?
Generate a 10-slide investor update for a Series A fintech
